def min_swaps_to_sort(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    target = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: arr[i])
    done = [False] * n
    swaps = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if done[i] or target[i] == i:
            continue
        cycle = 0
        j = i
        while not done[j]:
            done[j] = True
            j = target[j]
            cycle += 1
        swaps += cycle - 1
    return swaps

    hour_str, minute_str = time_part.split(':')

    return f'{hour:02d}:{minute_str}'
